basics.name: Ray Sun
basics.label: Circuit Designer | Maker | DIY Enthusiast
basics.summary: Hi I'm Ray! I create high-speed, performance-critical systems spanning analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits, RF electronics, biomedical sensors, and other technologies. I'm drawn to where physical insight, computational power, and hands-on engineering come together at the edge of what's possible.
